name: Finanzas
description: Operational and personal finance team for Mexican SMBs and individuals: controller (lead), financial analyst, tax compliance and personal finance advisor. Keeps a lightweight revenue ledger (sales, abonos, IVA by treatment, CFDI export data), and prepares financial statements, monthly accountant packages, SAT obligation calendars, financial ratios, project evaluation (NPV/IRR), break-even and pricing, household budgets and debt payoff plans. Tax content is indicative and always validated with the accountant.
